data.title: MediaLoom Engine Architecture Root
data.description: Root of the MediaLoom multimedia ingestion and distillation engine.

data.title: Three-Path Transcription Strategy (Fast, Heavy, Slow)
data.description: Probe official/auto captions first (zero cost, 2-5 seconds). Fallback to yt-dlp format 140 + Whisper when subtitles are unavailable. Last resort: Slow Track browser playback capture with pitch-preserving playbackRate 1.5x-2.0x and timestamp rescale t_original = t_asr * rate.

data.title: Slow Track Browser Playback Capture
data.description: When captions and protocol extraction fail, Playwright plays the operator-accessible watch page, records HTMLMediaElement.captureStream() audio at playbackRate 1.5-2.0, then rescales ASR timestamps onto the original timeline. OS loopback is last resort only.

data.title: 16kHz Mono Downsampling & 24MB ASR Boundary
data.description: Cloud Whisper API enforces a 25MB upload limit. Format 140 audio over 24MB is downsampled to 16kHz mono 32kbps MP3 via imageio-ffmpeg, reducing file size by ~75% without compromising ASR word error rate.

data.title: Native Chapter Scaffolding & Timestamp Anchors
data.description: Extract creator-defined chapters to segment speech into natural topical units and generate hyperlinked timestamp URLs for all claims and skills.
